'''Sector Lambda''' was an area on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]. During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Rogue Ten/Legends|Rogue Ten]] crashed
into the area and was pinned down by [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] walkers.
